note: WAEC Government round 5 (R27 top-up): waziri and alkali of the emirate, Igbo age grades, Oyomesi's check on the Alaafin; Macaulay's NNDP 1923, Zik's NCNC, Awolowo's free education, Bello's NPC; 1963 republic, 1979 executive presidency, Gowon's 12 states of 1967, Abacha's 36 of 1996, the January 1966 coup; bicameralism, 109 senators, 360 House members; first-past-the-post, proportional representation, referendum; Senate confirmation, four-year presidential term; judicial review, Supreme Court as final court; NLC as occupational group, lobbying; non-alignment, Africa as centrepiece; Security Council veto, General Assembly equal votes, OAU to AU 2002; the 1976 uniform local government reform; why federalism was adopted. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-4, NECO Government (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
